name: Bed bids
summary: Who sleeps where at the rental: a floor plan with the beds drawn in and a pillow per spot; better beds cost a little more and the floor less while the total stays the rental's price; tap a pillow to claim it and lock when everyone has a bed.
useWhen: more people than beds at an Airbnb: 'one queen, one double, a couch and an air mattress for six'
'i'll pay extra for the queen' or 'whoever gets the air mattress should pay less'
splitting a rental fairly when the beds aren't equal
dontUseWhen: splitting the rental evenly with no bed fight (use a bill split)
choosing which rental to book (use a poll)
trip costs beyond the place (use trip-suitcase)

premiumCents.description: per spot, above or below an even share; should sum to 0 over all spots

beds.description: 1 to 5 beds in up to 4 rooms

claimed.description: Who already has a spot, by bed index
